title: Bulk band structure and node line
action: Construct the 4×4 tight-binding Hamiltonian in momentum space using the given lattice parameters (a=4.34 Å, b=5.50 Å, c=10.49 Å) and hopping parameters (ε, t1∥, t2∥, t3∥, t4∥, t1⊥, t2⊥). Diagonalize on a dense grid in the T–Z–Γ plane and along the high-symmetry path Γ–Z–T to obtain eigenvalues. Identify the closed node line where the two central bands cross near the Fermi level.
description: JSON containing the high-symmetry k-point path with fractional coordinates and labels, the eigenvalues (4 per k-point) in eV, and the list of node-line points (fractional coordinates) forming a closed loop around Z.

title: Berry phase for zigzag termination
action: For the zigzag-terminated (100) surface, compute the Berry phase along the k₁ momentum direction for a grid of in-plane momenta (k₂,k₃) covering the projected node line. Use the discretized F-matrix method to obtain the Berry phase modulo 2π, normalized to units of π.
description: JSON containing arrays of in-plane momenta (k∥ = [k₂,k₃] in fractional coordinates) and the corresponding Berry phase in units of π.

title: Beard-type (100) surface states
action: Construct the tight-binding Hamiltonian for an 80-layer slab of the beard-terminated (100) surface using the basis and matrix elements defined for this termination. Diagonalize along a path in the surface Brillouin zone that covers the projected node ring to obtain slab eigenvalues.
description: JSON containing the k-point path along the surface BZ and the eigenvalues (in eV) for all slab bands.
